task: Find NVIDIA in both registries (GLEIF, SEC EDGAR) and compare what each says: agreements, differences, match confidence.

entities.name: NVIDIA CORP
entities.business_address: 2788 San Tomas Expressway, Santa Clara, CA 95051

entities.name: NVIDIA CORPORATION
entities.legal_address: C/O Corporation Service Company, 251 Little Falls Drive, Wilmington, DE 19808
entities.headquarters_address: 2788 San Tomas Expressway, Santa Clara, CA 95051

findings.statement: EDGAR CIK 0001045810 (NVIDIA CORP) and GLEIF LEI 549300S4KLFTLO7GSQ80 (NVIDIA CORPORATION) are a possible match — needs confirmation via ID, but strongly corroborated by an exact headquarters-address match and matching Delaware jurisdiction/state of incorporation.
No shared identifier exists between the two records: EDGAR's own 'lei' field for CIK 0001045810 is null, so the join is by name plus address/jurisdiction corroboration, not by ID.
Both registries agree the entity is headquartered at 2788 San Tomas Expressway, Santa Clara, CA 95051.
Both registries agree the entity is incorporated/domiciled in Delaware (EDGAR: stateOfIncorporation=DE; GLEIF: jurisdiction=US-DE, legal address in Wilmington DE).
Legal name differs by suffix style only: 'NVIDIA CORP' (EDGAR) vs 'NVIDIA CORPORATION' (GLEIF); not a disagreement about identity.
EDGAR carries EIN (943177549), ticker (NVDA), SIC code (3674), former name history, and a full filing history that GLEIF does not carry at all.

GLEIF carries a Delaware state registration number (registeredAs 2862596 / ocid us_de/2862596), a distinct registered-agent legal address, and a corporate family tree (3 direct subsidiaries) that EDGAR's submissions record does not carry.

A GLEIF name search on 'NVIDIA' surfaces non-company entities named after NVIDIA, e.g. 'Defiance Nvidia Ventures ETF' (LEI 529900YQV0X0R0T0AZ11) and 'NINEPOINT NVIDIA HIGHSHARES ETF' (LEI 894500UB1PEXN75HFT11), both category=FUND, plus the true subsidiary 'NVIDIA INTERNATIONAL, INC.' (LEI 549300EK80J3WR5TSA69). These were excluded as candidates for the parent operating company but are possible matches for other, narrower questions.

An EDGAR full-text search for 'NVIDIA' returns 2,417 hits, most of which are filings that merely mention NVIDIA (insider Form 3/4/5 filers, other companies' Schedule 13G naming NVIDIA) rather than filings by NVIDIA itself; only rows carrying CIK 0001045810 as registrant were used for this comparison.

data_gaps: Neither registry covers financial statements narrative, sanctions, or litigation (per ./CATALOG.md).
GLEIF record has no EIN field; EDGAR record has no LEI value populated (null), so no field-level EIN/LEI cross-check was possible.
GLEIF's subsidiary list (direct-children) was not cross-checked against EDGAR's Exhibit 21 subsidiary disclosures in this run.
GLEIF's ultimate-parent/ultimate-children relationships and isins relationship were not fetched in this run.
GLEIF full name-history (otherNames) is empty for this record, so no comparison was possible against EDGAR's formerNames array beyond noting the gap.
